metadata.abstract: © 2020 The Author(s) 2020. Published by Oxford University Press. All rights reserved. For permissions, please e-mail: journals.permissions@oup.com.CONAN is a web application developed to detect specificity determinants and function-related sites by amino acids co-variation networks analysis, emphasizing local coevolutionary constraints. The software allows the characterization of structurally and functionally relevant groups of residues and their relationship with subsets of sequences by automatic cross-referencing with GO terms, UniprotKb annotations and INTERPRO.
